description: Perched along a peaceful road in sought-after Montclair, this stunning mid-century modern retreat offers exceptional privacy, natural beauty, and a seamless connection to its surroundings.   Designed for effortless entertaining and everyday living, the open-concept floor plan features soaring ceilings, a sleek stone fireplace, and a dramatic wall of windows that floods the home with natural light while framing tranquil Bay and valley views.
